name: logo-material-explorer
title_zh: 平面logo变立体材质，品牌特征一条不丢
tagline_zh: 给甲方看效果前，先自己把字标挤出、倒角、上材质。内置常用表面库，不用翻贴图网站，品牌色和负空间自动守住。
tagline_en: Extrude, bevel, and surface your wordmark before client reviews. Built-in material library keeps brand colors and.
desc_en: Use when a user wants to turn a flat logo, wordmark, monogram, or brand mark into a dimensional 3D material study, compare extrusion geometry, or apply a supplied or built-in surface reference while preserving brand identity.
why_zh: 不是简单加个厚度。它把品牌识别拆成可参数化的几何约束，挤出方向、倒角半径、表面纹理都跟着原标走。
why_en: Not just an extrude. It parameterizes brand identity into geometry constraints, so bevels and textures follow the original.
limit_zh: 只吃纯色扁平源文件（SVG/PNG 白底），渐变或复杂描边需先手动简化。产物是静帧渲染图，不出动画。
limit_en: Accepts flat solid-color SVG/PNG on white only; gradients need manual cleanup. Outputs still renders—no animation, no printable mesh.
title_en: Turn flat logos into 3D material studies
